Defend the emperor's cook as he dishes out food to the hungry.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Protect the emperor's cook as he serves soup to the poor.
* See [[Imperial Guardsman Kintae]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 175 [[Gold]]
* [[Imperial Commendation]]

==Walkthrough==
Follow the western edge of the [[Bukdek Byway]] until you reach [[Imperial Chef Yileng]]. You can wait for the two mobs of [[Afflicted]] to approach your position, but it is safer to move up the ramp the Chef faces and block the Afflicted right on the bridge, fighting them there.

{{anomaly|Sometimes the second group of Afflicted gets stuck with fighting the peasants by the big hole before both of the bridges. If so, you'll have to run all the way down to the hole and kill them there.}}

==NPCs==
===Allies===
[[Human]]s
*{{x}} 10 [[Imperial Chef Yileng]]

==Dialogues==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Imperial Guardsman Kintae'''
:''"As the plague worsens, the poor are being hit the hardest. Food prices have climbed uncontrollably as farmers and merchants have slowed shipments to Kaineng City for fear of infection. Charitable funds have dried up as people worry only for themselves. The emperor is concerned for his people, especially the poor and elderly, and has mandated that his personal cooks prepare food for them. It is a gracious gesture by our emperor, but the [[Imperial Guard]] has no men to spare to protect the cooks while they distribute soup to the needy. If you are loyal to the emperor, go to '''Bukdek Byway''' and help protect '''Imperial Chef Yileng'''"''
{{offer dialog
|accept = I will protect the cook on the noble quest.
|decline = I'm no man's chowder hound!
|ask = If you would like to help the emperor and the suffering citizens of Kaineng City, travel to '''Bukdek Byway''' and protect '''Imperial Chef Yileng'''. 
|indent = :: }}

===Reward dialogue===
'''Imperial Guardsman Kintae'''
:''"It is a noble gesture indeed to help protect those who cannot protect themselves. You will always be a friend of the Imperial Guard. I cannot thank you enough."''
